1.text: Zaburi iyi ni iya Asafu.Ni ukuri Imana igirira neza Abisirayeli,Bafite imitima iboneye.

2.text: Ariko jyeweho,Ibirenge byanjye byari bugufi bwo guhanuka,Intambwe zanjye zari zishigaje hato zikanyerera.

3.text: Kuko nagiriraga ishyari abibone,Ubwo narebaga abanyabyaha baguwe neza.

4.text: Kuko batababazwa mu ipfa ryabo,Ahubwo imbaraga zabo zirakomera.

6.text: Ni cyo gituma ubwibone buba nk'urunigi mu majosi yabo,Urugomo rukabatwikīra nk'igishura.

7.text: Amaso yabo avanywe imutwe no kubyibuha kwabo,Bafite ibiruta ibyo umutima w'umuntu wakwifuza.

8.text: Barakoba bakavugishwa iby'agahato no gukiranirwa kwabo,Bavuga iby'ubwibone.

9.text: Bashyize akanwa kabo mu ijuru,Ururimi rwabo ruzerera mu isi yose.

10.text: Ni cyo gituma abantu be bagaruka aho,Bakamara amazi yuzuye mu gikombe,

11.text: Bakavuga bati “Imana ikibwirwa n'iki?Isumbabyose hari icyo izi?”

12.text: Dore abo ni bo banyabyaha,Kandi kuko bagira amahoro iteka bagwiza ubutunzi.

13.text: Ni ukuri nogereje ubusa umutima wanjye,Kudacumura nagukarabiye ubusa.

14.text: Kuko natewe n'ibyago umunsi ukira,Ngahanwa ibihano mu bitondo byose.

15.text: Iyaba naravuze nti “Reka mvuge ntyo”,Mba narahemukiye ubwoko bw'abana bawe.

17.text: Kugeza aho nagiriye ahera h'Imana,Nkita ku iherezo rya ba bandi.

19.text: Erega bahindutse amatongo mu kanya gato!Ubwoba bw'uburyo bwinshi burabatsembye rwose.

20.text: Nk'uko inzozi zimeze iyo umuntu akangutse,Ni ko nawe Mwami nukanguka,Uzasuzugura icyubahiro cyabo cy'igicucu.

21.text: Ubwo umutima wanjye washariraga,Nkibabaza mu mutima,

22.text: Nari umupfapfa nta bwenge nagiraga,Nameraga nk'inka imbere yawe.

23.text: Ariko none ndi kumwe nawe iteka,Umfashe ukuboko kw'iburyo.

24.text: Uzanyoboza ubwenge bwawe,Kandi hanyuma uzanyakirane icyubahiro.

25.text: Ni nde mfite mu ijuru utari wowe?Kandi mu isi nta we nishimira utari wowe.

26.text: Umubiri wanjye n'umutima wanjye birashira,Ariko Imana ni yo gitare umutima wanjye uhungiraho,Kandi ni yo mugabane wanjye iteka ryose.

27.text: Kuko abakujya kure bazarimbuka,Watsembye abakurekeshejwe no kurarikira bose.

28.text: Ariko jyeweho kwegera Imana ni ko kwiza kuri jye,Umwami Uwiteka ni we ngize ubuhungiro,Kugira ngo namamaze imirimo wakoze yose.
